answer: A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The lantern counter is kept in signal and sparrow exposes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 47 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
